title: DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated September 1, 2026, relative to a donation valued at $5,000.00
text:
[3. CONSENT AGENDA ITEMS]
DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated September 1, 2026, relative to a donation valued at $5,000.00
  for Hollywood Community Police Station equipment, as set forth.  [BPC #26-272]

  Recommendation(s) for Board action:

  APPROVE the Department’s report.
summary: Approval of $5,000 donation for Hollywood Community Police Station equipment.
